sample_mapping_evidence: GEO explicitly identifies P023 baseline and 12-month blood observations. Primary PMID40543509 confirms longitudinal total-blood-T analysis. Two visits share one donor; sorted/pool libraries and larger clinical cohorts not independent RNA observations.

source_processing: The raw data files were demultiplexed into FASTQ file by cellranger mkfastq. v.7.1.0. Then reads were aligned against GRCh38 human reference genome 2020-A provided by 10x Genomics based on GENCODE v32/Ensembl98

Using the Read10X function of the Seurat v.4.9.9 package of R v.4.2.2, we loaded expression data from the cellranger count pipeline into R and then created Seurat Object by CreateSeuratObject, with the selection criterion being cells expressing at least 200 genes expressed in more than 3 cells.

Cells with 300-5000 unique genses and < 20% mitochondrial reads were retained for downstream analyses. Doublets were removed by DoubletFinder v.2.0.4. Count matrices were merged to a single Seurat object.
Log normalized counts were used to identify 2000 most variably expressed genes using the FindVariableFeatures function with the variance stabilizing transformation.

Integration was performed using respectively SelectIntegrationFeatures, PrepSCTIntegration and FindIntegrationAnchors of Seurat. Principal component (PC) analysis was performed, and the first 10 PCs were selected for UMAP dimensionality reduction.
To cluster cells, we first used Seurat's FindNeighbors method to determine the biologically closest cells, before grouping them together using Seurat's FindClusters function with a resolution of 0.3.
Supplementary files format and content: Tab-separate values files and matrix files
source_metadata.source_barcode_scope: Original raw droplet whitelist; barcode rows are not called cells. Existing minimum RNA QC applied before constructing AnnData; no new threshold or RNA count changes.

title: P023, PBMC, Baseline, scRNAseq
treatment_protocol_ch1: PBMC from selected patients were thawed and in vitro stimulated during 6 days with vaccinated-derived peptides
extract_protocol_ch1: PBMC isolated from blood patient were stored in cryostore in liquid nitrogen, then defrozed in water bath at 37C, the cells were resuspended in RMPI 20% human serum, centrifuged at low speed for 7 min. metadata.source_preparation: GEO PBMC source; primary describes analysis of total blood T cells. Do not assume unrestricted lineage composition.
metadata.source_demographics: Individual sex/exact collection dates/outcomes not joined; no imputation
metadata.source_alias_review: Two blood observations from one patient. Additional IFN-positive sorted fractions and a two-person pooled capture are not additional independent blood specimens.

metadata.source_access_limitation: GEO reports lost raw sequencing files for these records; supplementary raw count matrices are a separate available source. Reprocessing from FASTQ cannot be promised.
